tooltip.darkspawn.magic_carpet: Place on clear solid ground to bind. Empty-hand use rides; sneak-use opens care. Amethyst repairs it.
message.darkspawn.magic_carpet_mounted: Magic Carpet: WASD to steer, Jump to rise, X to descend, Sneak to dismount. Land before packing.
message.darkspawn.magic_carpet_blocked: Carpet needs clear, dry, loaded space above solid ground.
message.darkspawn.magic_carpet_placed: Carpet bound to you. Empty-hand use rides; sneak-use opens Follow/Stay and storage. A companion capsule packs it safely.
